exampleSentences.text: Timetabling constraints inhibit all learners from studying a language in 55 per cent of responding schools.

exampleSentences.text: Limited language skills can hinder students’ social and contextual experiences, leading to frustration, isolation and disengagement, which increases their vulnerability to stress and withdrawal.
exampleSentences.translation: 有限的语言能力会妨碍学生的社交和情境体验，导致挫败、孤立和疏离，并使他们更容易承受压力和产生退缩情绪。

exampleSentences.text: For example, many governments around the world set CEFR level B1 as an objective for language learning either for the end of secondary education, or for university graduates.

exampleSentences.text: The aim of this study is to provide evidence of the validity of the IELTS Speaking Test based on test content.
